items.name: The Academy Graduate
items.description: You represent the elite tier of institutional training. You didn't just join the service; you were forged by it, learning that leadership is a burden and doctrine is a shield.
items.equipment: A pristine dress uniform, a standard-issue officer's sidearm, a tactical holomap projector, and a low-level clearance badge.
items.special_ability: **Tactical Evaluation:** You have a -1 step bonus to [Awareness-Perception](/skills/awareness/#perception) or [Tactics-Infantry Tactics](/skills/tactics/#infantry-tactics) checks made specifically to evaluate an opponent's combat formation, defensive weaknesses, or equipment quality before an engagement begins.
items.tendencies:
**The Officer in Charge:** Assert your rank or authority to take command of a chaotic situation, even when doing so makes you the primary target for enemies or social scrutiny.
**The Strategist:** Refuse to deviate from a sophisticated or "correct" tactical plan even when a simpler, more "rugged" solution is available, prioritizing the doctrine you were taught.

items.name: The Bounty Hunter
items.description: The galaxy is vast, but for you, it is just a series of footprints and digital trails. You live for the contract and the satisfaction of a closed case.
items.flaw: [Powerful Enemy](/perks_flaws/#powerful-enemy) (Someone you caught, or someone you’re currently hunting who has the upper hand).
items.equipment: An armored longcoat, two sets of heavy-duty binders, a tracking fob/scanner, and a heavy pistol or stun baton.
items.special_ability: **Skip Tracer:** You have a -1 step bonus to [Investigate-Search](/skills/investigate/#search) checks when looking for information regarding a specific individual's current location or recent history.
items.tendencies:
**The Single-Minded:** Pursue a target or a lead into a clearly dangerous or disadvantageous situation instead of choosing a safer, slower path.
**The Professional:** Honor the specific letter of a contract even when offered a more profitable "side deal" or an easier moral out.

items.name: The Certified Psychic
items.description: You are an autonomous legal entity, granted the rare authority to use psionic powers openly. You act as an arbiter in high-stakes negotiations and possess the legal right to probe minds in situ if you determine there is reasonable cause.
items.flaw: [Code of Honor](/perks_flaws/#code-of-honor) (Absolute neutrality and adherence to the strict ethical guidelines of your autonomous certification).
items.equipment: An official arbiter's badge/warrant, a portable recording device, formal professional wear, and mild sedatives/stimulants for psychic strain.
items.special_ability: **Autonomous Arbiter:** Your psionic verification is legally binding. You receive a -1 step bonus to [Interaction](/skills/interaction/) or [Law](/skills/law/) checks when acting as a neutral third party in negotiations or when asserting your legal right to verify the truth of a statement in the field.
items.tendencies:
**The Absolute Truth:** Force a harsh or dangerous truth out into the open to maintain your absolute neutrality, even when a polite lie or deception would have made things easier for the party.
**The Unwanted Judge:** Complicate a situation by acting on a crime or dark secret you gleaned from someone's mind, using your autonomous authority to intervene when it wasn't your fight.

items.name: The Criminal / Urchin
items.description: Life on the streets taught you how to survive, but it left you with a name that the authorities won't forget.
items.equipment: A well-used physical or electronic entry kit, a burner comm-link, a forged low-tier ID, and a reliable street-made weapon (like a shiv or a holdout pistol).
items.special_ability: None. (Your raw survival instincts are instead reflected mechanically by receiving a free broad skill to represent your foundational street upbringing).
items.tendencies:
**The Opportunist:** Take an unnecessary risk to secure a personal profit or an "angle."
**The Paranoiac:** Compromise a plan to ensure you have a clear escape route.

items.name: The Deserter
items.description: You are a ghost in the machine. You have the reflexes of a soldier but the soul of a fugitive.
items.equipment: A military-grade weapon (with filed-off serial numbers), a rugged survival tent or sleeping roll, and a high-quality fake ident-card.
items.special_ability: **Safehouse Intuition:** You have a -1 step bonus to find makeshift shelter, black-market supplies, or sympathetic contacts in hostile territory.
items.tendencies:
**The Pragmatic Escape:** Abandon a cause when the risks become "unacceptable" to ensure your survival.
**The Hidden Hand:** Pass up fame or reward to ensure your identity remains undiscovered.

items.name: The Diplomat
items.description: You were raised in the halls of power, where protocol is a weapon and reputation is everything.
items.equipment: A tailored high-society suit, an encrypted datapad with a localized legal codex, and a ceremonial or easily concealable sidearm.
items.special_ability: **Diplomatic Immunity:** In settled systems, you are often exempt from minor local laws and routine searches while on official business. This immunity extends strictly to your person and your personal cabin aboard a vessel, unless the ship itself is registered as a diplomatic transport. You receive a -1 step bonus to checks involving legal navigation.
items.tendencies:
**The Mediator:** Attempt to resolve a hostile situation through negotiation even when combat is easier.
**The Architect:** Delay action to ensure every social variable or consequence is accounted for.

items.name: The Face
items.description: You are a master of the "hustle." Whether you're scrounging restricted supplies or talking your way past a security checkpoint, you use your charm to requisition the impossible.
items.flaw: [Obsessed](/perks_flaws/#obsessed) (With maintaining your public image, luxury standards, or personal vanity).
items.equipment: An extravagant wardrobe suitable for high-end venues, a cosmetic disguise kit, and a flashy but low-caliber sidearm.
items.special_ability: **The Scrounger:** You have a -1 step bonus to [Interaction-Bargain](/skills/interaction/#bargain) or [Street Smart-Street Knowledge](/skills/street-smart/#street-knowledge) checks when trying to acquire specific equipment or restricted items through non-monetary means (cons, favors, or "borrowing").
items.tendencies:
**The Spotlight Seeker:** Intentionally draw attention to yourself in a social setting to create a distraction, even when being inconspicuous is safer.
**The Hustler:** Attempt to "scam" or talk your way out of a problem or into a restricted area using your personal appeal, even when a more direct (but less elegant) method exists.

items.name: The Fixer
items.description: You know everyone, you owe everyone, and you're the only one who can get the job done.
items.flaw: [Powerful Enemy](/perks_flaws/#powerful-enemy) (A dangerous character or slighted client).
items.equipment: An untraceable comm-link, a pocket full of varied currency or physical trade chits, and a concealed weapon.
items.special_ability: **"I Know a Guy.":** Once per session, you can locate a specific item, character, or piece of information with a -2 step bonus, finding it in half the normal time.
items.tendencies:
**The Negotiator:** Solve a conflict by brokering a deal that moves the plot forward.
**The Asset Manager:** Risk an objective to preserve a useful contact or piece of equipment.

items.name: The Fleet Officer
items.description: While ground forces fight for meters, you fight for systems. You understand the complex dance of starship systems and the strategic weight of the high ground in the void.
items.flaw: [Code of Honor](/perks_flaws/#code-of-honor) (Strict adherence to naval protocol and superiority).
items.equipment: A naval uniform, a personal void-suit (vacuum suit) designed for zero-G emergencies, and an officer's sidearm.
items.special_ability: **Bridge Intuition:** You have a -1 step bonus to all [System Operation](/skills/system-operation/) specialty skill checks while on the bridge of a starship, representing your deep familiarity with fleet-standard interfaces and emergency protocols.
items.tendencies:
**The Ship’s Soul:** Prioritize the structural integrity and long-term maintenance of the vessel over personal equipment or mission objectives.
**The Protocol Purist:** Insist on following standard naval communications and engagement protocols even when operating in the "wild" or with civilian crews, potentially causing social friction.

items.name: The Hacker
items.description: You grew up in the digital shadows, viewing the physical world as a secondary reality. Firewalls are just puzzles, corporate secrets are currency, and you've made a living bypassing the unbreakable.
items.flaw: [Obsessed](/perks_flaws/#obsessed) (With digital security and uncovering conspiracies, making you overly cautious and prone to distrusting physical allies).
items.equipment: A high-end custom cyberdeck or illegal intrusion rig, a biometric spoofer, an encrypted burner drive, and a mild stimulant supply.
items.special_ability: **Backdoor Access:** You receive a -1 step bonus to [Computer Science-Hacking](/skills/computer-science/#hacking) or [Security-Security Devices](/skills/security/#security-devices) checks when attempting to bypass digital security, decrypt files, or spoof electronic access logs.
items.tendencies:
**The Digital Ghost:** Prioritize erasing your digital footprint or stealing secondary data over the physical safety or immediate tactical needs of the party.
**The Curious Intruder:** Cannot resist poking into a secure system or locked file even when it has nothing to do with the current mission and risks triggering alarms.

items.name: The Military Brat
items.description: You grew up in the shadow of the service. You don't have the "character" genes, but you have the discipline.
items.equipment: A piece of surplus military gear (like a rugged fatigue jacket or combat boots), a basic field medkit, and a standard-issue sidearm.
items.special_ability: **Standard Procedure:** You have a -1 step bonus to [Resolve-Mental Resolve](/skills/resolve-con/#mental-resolve) or [Resolve-Physical Resolve](/skills/resolve-con/#physical-resolve) checks during high-stress situations as long as you are following a clear, pre-established plan or order.
items.tendencies:
**The Order-Follower:** Adhere to a plan or instruction even when circumstances have shifted.
**The Protector:** Put yourself at risk to cover an ally's flank.

items.name: The Outcast
items.description: You come from a place where technology is magic and survival is the only law.
items.equipment: A sturdy archaic weapon (like a spear, bow, or heavy blade), a survival knife, tribal or clan tokens, and rugged survival clothing.
items.special_ability: None. (Your survival is bought with a wide array of raw, physical skills).
items.tendencies:
**The Traditionalist:** Solve a modern problem using an ancient, low-tech, or ritualistic method.
**The Loner:** Take a disadvantage to handle a task entirely on your own, refusing the help of "soft" technology or teammates.

items.name: The Paramilitary Officer
items.description: You didn't train at a prestigious academy or fight under a planetary flag. You learned to command in the grueling, profit-driven world of private military companies or local militias, where logistics are scarce and victory goes to the pragmatic.
items.flaw: [Code of Honor](/perks_flaws/#code-of-honor) (The Mercenary's Code: You never break a signed contract, you never betray a client who has paid in full, and you expect subordinates to follow your orders without question).
items.equipment: A personalized, non-standard suit of tactical armor, a heavily modified assault rifle, a digital contract ledger, and a squad-level encrypted comms unit.
items.special_ability: **Asymmetrical Warfare:** You receive a -1 step bonus to [Tactics-Infantry Tactics](/skills/tactics/#infantry-tactics) or [Survival-Survival Training](/skills/survival/#survival-training) checks when executing an ambush, fighting a guerrilla campaign, or operating entirely cut off from official supply lines.
items.tendencies:
**The Mercenary:** Demand renegotiation, hazard pay, or a clear tactical advantage before committing to a dangerous firefight that wasn't in the original plan.
**The Pragmatist:** Disregard traditional rules of engagement or "honorable" doctrine in favor of traps, sabotage, or overwhelming disproportionate force.

items.name: The Ship Owner
items.description: You hold the keys to the most valuable asset in the galaxy: a starship. However, that kind of hardware isn't cheap, and you signed your soul away to a cartel, bank, or shadowy benefactor to get it.
items.flaw: [Debt Ridden](/perks_flaws/#debt-ridden) (You owe a massive debt on your vessel. Unlike other flaws, this cannot be bought off with XP during character advancement; it can only be removed by physically paying off the creditor in-game. Furthermore, if you miss a payment, the creditor can make demands, forcing you to take dangerous jobs or favor their interests to keep the ship).
items.equipment: A captain's coat, a heavy spanner or multi-tool, and a personal distress beacon linked to your ship.
items.special_ability: **Captain and Commander:** You begin the game in possession of a starship capable of interstellar travel and accommodating the entire party.
items.tendencies:
**The Bottom Line:** Make a tactical or narrative decision strictly based on financial gain or the physical preservation of your ship, ignoring moral pleas or personal risks.
**My Ship, My Rules:** Assert your absolute authority over a situation or passenger while aboard your vessel, even when deferring to an ally or expert would be significantly safer.

items.name: The Smuggler
items.description: You make your living in the gray areas between borders and laws. Moving illicit cargo requires a steady nerve, knowledge of the black market, and the ability to lie to an inspector’s face.
items.flaw: [Powerful Enemy](/perks_flaws/#powerful-enemy) (A relentless customs inspector or a syndicate boss you double-crossed).
items.equipment: An oversized coat with hidden sensor-baffled pockets, a holdout blaster, a physical ledger, and a set of fake transponder codes or IDs.
items.special_ability: **Smuggler's Hold:** You receive a -1 step bonus to [Covert Ops-Conceal](/skills/covert-ops/#conceal) checks when hiding objects, data, or people from physical inspections or routine sensor sweeps.
items.tendencies:
**The Contrabandist:** Take a narrative or tactical risk to sneak something illegal or restricted into a secure area, even if the current mission doesn't strictly require it.
**The Burner:** Dump valuable cargo, abandon a lucrative deal, or cut ties with a useful contact at the first sign of official scrutiny to ensure your own freedom.

items.name: The Subverter
items.description: You use your art not for the galleries, but for the streets. You are a propagandist, a hacker of public spaces, and an agitator who knows that a well-placed image can do more damage than a bomb.
items.favored_specialty_skills:
[Creativity-Specific Skill](/skills/creativity/#creativity-specific-skill) (e.g., holo art, public graffiti, or propaganda design)
[Deception-Bluff](/skills/deception/#bluff)
[Covert Ops-Stealth](/skills/covert-ops/#stealth)
[Leadership-Inspire](/skills/leadership/#inspire)
items.favored_perks: [Powerful Ally](/perks_flaws/#powerful-ally) (An underground resistance movement, anarchist collective, or decentralized hacker group).
items.flaw: [Infamy](/perks_flaws/#infamy) (Known to local authorities or megacorporations as a dangerous vandal and agitator).
items.equipment: A portable signal-hijacker or high-yield spray tech, an encrypted data-drive full of propaganda, a breather mask to obscure your face, and rugged street clothes.
items.special_ability: **Subliminal Messaging:** You have a -1 step bonus to [Leadership-Inspire](/skills/leadership/#inspire) or [Deception-Bluff](/skills/deception/#bluff) checks when you use your art to incite a crowd, cause a public distraction, or rapidly sway public opinion.
items.tendencies:
**The Calling Card:** Leave a recognizable piece of your art or propaganda at the scene of a mission, intentionally drawing attention to yourself and risking immediate discovery.
**The Agitator:** Openly provoke authority figures or corporate security, using the resulting chaos to make a political point even if it jeopardizes the current operation.

items.name: The Virtuoso
items.description: You are a master of aesthetics and performance. Your work is highly sought after by the galactic elite, but true art requires an uncompromising vision that often clashes with practical reality.
items.flaw: [Temper](/perks_flaws/#temper) (A volatile artistic ego that flares up unpredictably when your work, vision, or status is criticized or interrupted).
items.equipment: High-end, custom-made creation tools (a bespoke holo-stylus or physical mediums), luxury attire, and a portable digital portfolio.
items.special_ability: **Patron's Favor & Catharsis:** You can leverage your artistic prestige to gain access to exclusive events or secure funding. You receive a -1 step bonus to [Interaction-Charm](/skills/interaction/#charm) or [Culture-Etiquette](/skills/culture/#etiquette-specific) checks when dealing with high-society patrons or art enthusiasts (this bonus improves to -2 steps if you possess the [Filthy Rich](/perks_flaws/#filthy-rich) perk). Additionally, engaging in your art provides psychological relief: if using the Persistent Stress optional rules, a successful [Creativity-Artistic Expression](/skills/creativity/#artistic-expression) check grants a +1 (Ordinary), +2 (Good), or +3 (Amazing) step bonus to Personality feats made to resist stress penalties.
items.tendencies:
**The Aesthete:** Choose a course of action based purely on its aesthetic appeal or dramatic flair rather than its tactical soundness or efficiency.
**The Diva:** Refuse to cooperate or compromise with the party until your specific, often petty, demands regarding comfort or artistic integrity are met.

items.name: The War Hero
items.description: You are defined by a single, highly publicized conflict. Whether you were an ace pilot, a combat medic, or the sole survivor of a doomed squad, the galaxy knows your face—and expects you to live up to the legend.
items.flaw: [Old Injury](/perks_flaws/#old-injury) (A lasting physical reminder of the event that made you famous).
items.equipment: A personalized or heavily battle-scarred signature weapon, official combat medals, a rugged military jacket, and a supply of medical painkillers.
items.special_ability: **Burden of Glory:** You receive a -1 step bonus to [Interaction](/skills/interaction/) or [Leadership](/skills/leadership/) skill checks when dealing with veterans, active military personnel, or patriotic citizens who recognize your service.
items.tendencies:
**The Living Legend:** Voluntarily accept a significant disadvantage or take the brunt of an attack to protect civilians or allies, driven by the need to live up to your impossible reputation.
**The Ghost of the Past:** React to a current situation using the outdated or traumatic context of your past war, complicating a simple negotiation or infiltration by treating it like a battlefield.

items.name: The Whistleblower
items.description: You are a relentless investigative journalist or freelance whistleblower. You use words to topple corporate empires and expose government corruption, making you a very dangerous person to know.
items.flaw: [Obsessed](/perks_flaws/#obsessed) (With uncovering the absolute truth of a situation, regardless of the danger it poses to yourself or your allies).
items.equipment: A high-end micro-recording rig, an official (or highly accurate forged) press pass, a burner comm-link, and a portable data-scrubber.
items.special_ability: **Off the Record:** You receive a -1 step bonus to [Interaction-Interview](/skills/interaction/#interview) or [Street Smart-Street Knowledge](/skills/street-smart/#street-knowledge) checks when trying to coax rumors, classified information, or unofficial statements out of a reluctant source.
items.tendencies:
**The Exposé:** Prioritize documenting a crime, conspiracy, or event over stopping it, putting yourself in tactical danger to ensure the footage or story survives.
**The Hard Question:** Aggressively interrogate or provoke a powerful individual in a social setting, destroying diplomatic progress in order to gauge their reaction.
